title: onoclea struthiopteris var. pensylvanica
intro:
Onoclea struthiopteris var. pensylvanica, commonly known as the American spleenwort, is a variety of the Onoclea struthiopteris fern species found in North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help reduce pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of American spleenwort include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: The information provided is based on available data, and more research may be needed to confirm the accuracy and effectiveness of the plant's health benefits, therapeutic actions, and bioactive constituents.
